Package index

Matching plant names

Match names against the World Flora Online backbone, keep one match per name, and check fuzzy matches.

WFO.match()
Match plant names against the World Flora Online taxonomic backbone
WFO.one()
Keep one match per submitted name
WFO.spelling.check()
Check whether fuzzy matches are explained by misspellings

Preparing names

Separate names and authors before matching.

WFO.prepare() WFO.preprepare()
Split full plant names into name and authorship

Getting the backbone

Download, read and remember the World Flora Online Plant List.

WFO.download() download_classification()
Download the World Flora Online taxonomic backbone
WFO.read() read_classification() WFO.remember()
Read and remember the taxonomic backbone
WFO.releases()
Releases of the backbone in the data folder

Other backbones

WFO.backbone() new.backbone()
Use another taxonomic backbone

Exploring the backbone

WFO.browse() WFO.synonyms() WFO.family() WFO.url()
Browse the taxonomic backbone: lower taxa, synonyms, family and order, web links

Data

WFO.example2026
Example subset of the World Flora Online taxonomic backbone (Plant List 2026-06)
WFO.example
Example subset of the World Flora Online taxonomic backbone (WorldFlora)
vascular.families
Orders and higher classification of vascular plant families
